description_policy.public_copy: Concrete outcomes, inspectable evidence, and clear limits, restricted to capabilities present in reviewed public source.
description_policy.stable_identity: Repository slugs, package names, dependency-sensitive paths, checksummed artifacts, and historical release names remain unchanged.
description_policy.version_language: Version numbers appear in public descriptions only when needed to explain a verified source or checksum-gated successor.
description_policy.live_metadata_enforcement: Source-controlled descriptions are canonical; live GitHub About-field drift is reported for manual correction.

repositories.name: botops-manager
repositories.expected_description: Windows operations console that centralizes launcher risk, health evidence, scoped process control, and redacted support data.
repositories.profile_summary: Verifies launchers and process ownership before control, consolidates health evidence, and creates limited, redacted support exports for independent Windows automation.

repositories.name: digital-asset-governance-case-study
repositories.expected_description: Read-only catalog audit that turns provenance, coverage, confidence, and duplicate candidates into a prioritized review queue.
repositories.profile_summary: Turns schema health, provenance coverage, confidence signals, and duplicate candidates into a prioritized stewardship queue with clear reasons and next steps using synthetic data.

repositories.name: media-tagger-bot
repositories.expected_description: Standardizes media libraries with evidence-based matching, dry-run review, journaled writes, and rollback.
repositories.profile_summary: Uses evidence-based matching, complete-scan gates, dry-run review, recorded changes, result verification, verified renames, and rollback manifests. Uncertain or preservation-sensitive files remain visible for review instead of being forced into a match.

repositories.name: chicago-food-inspections-analysis
repositories.expected_description: Reproducible analysis of 13,333 Chicago food-inspection records across three ZIP codes, 2010–2018.
repositories.profile_summary: Reproducibly analyzes 13,333 public inspection records, separates outcome from facility risk, and surfaces decision-relevant follow-up questions without overstating the data.

repositories.name: avalon-q-supervisor
repositories.expected_description: Local-first Avalon Q supervisor that turns device telemetry into health states, bounded recovery, and auditable operator decisions.
repositories.profile_summary: Turns local device telemetry into clear health states, requires separate configuration and runtime gates before recovery, enforces durable restart limits, and records privacy-conscious decision evidence.

repositories.name: automation-reliability-case-studies
repositories.expected_description: Reliability patterns that limit duplicate actions, bound recovery, and preserve decision evidence across automation systems.
repositories.profile_summary: Three documented studies show how outcome checks, identity-bound supervision, integrity verification, limited recovery, and explicit stop conditions contain risk across uncertain system boundaries.

repositories.name: beta-earth
repositories.expected_description: Working local-first Python RPG with layered architecture, validated content, revision-safe saves, and an accessible HUD.
repositories.profile_summary: A working local-first Python RPG with portable launchers, resilient saves, release validation, and verified public source at v0.4.11. The newer recorded v0.5.0 final remains visible behind an exact-source checksum gate instead of being falsely represented by the older tree.

repositories.name: safe-video-downloader
repositories.expected_description: Controlled retrieval of authorized media with rights confirmation, duplicate controls, isolated workers, and verified output.
repositories.profile_summary: Retrieves authorized media through shared desktop and command-line planning, public-network checks, duplicate controls, isolated workers, fallback media-signature validation, accurate status for mixed-result batches, and verified output.

repositories.name: mp3-downloader
repositories.expected_description: Controlled conversion of authorized media URLs into validated MP3s with preflight, bounded recovery, and duplicate reconciliation.
repositories.profile_summary: Turns one authorized URL into a validated MP3 through metadata preflight, retry limits, SHA-256 and SQLite duplicate reconciliation, visible output, and tightly redacted support exports.

repositories.name: image-downloader
repositories.expected_description: Controlled, permission-aware image collection with bounded discovery, duplicate controls, resumable state, and verified output.
repositories.profile_summary: Collects permitted images with controlled discovery, time-limited network requests, evidence that redacts sensitive URL details, Windows-safe filenames, resumable state, layered duplicate controls, and atomic finalization.

repositories.name: large-text-chunker
repositories.expected_description: Prepares oversized documents for downstream workflows with readable chunking, integrity metadata, and exact reconstruction.
repositories.profile_summary: Splits local documents at readable boundaries, preserves configurable context, records SHA-256 integrity metadata, and verifies exact reconstruction. Public source remains v1.0.0; the exact checksum-matched v1.10.0 archive is recovered and awaiting controlled source promotion.

repositories.name: net-loss-doctor
repositories.expected_description: Time-bounded Windows network triage with comparable evidence, redacted handoff, and no configuration changes.
repositories.profile_summary: Correlates gateway, route, DNS, TCP, latency, Windows event, and optional trace evidence into time-boxed, redacted support packages without changing network configuration.

repositories.name: lan-router-comms
repositories.expected_description: Cloud-free, authenticated text and resumable file exchange between paired Windows computers on a trusted LAN.
repositories.profile_summary: Provides cloud-free authenticated text and resumable file exchange between trusted Windows PCs using durable queues, replay protection, session limits, and verified delivery receipts.

repositories.name: windows-health-audit
repositories.expected_description: Read-only Windows health baseline for consistent triage, privacy-preserving evidence, and controlled support handoff.
repositories.profile_summary: Creates a read-only, non-elevated Windows health baseline with failure-isolated collectors, privacy-preserving normalization, transparent review thresholds, and no network or system changes.

repositories.name: inbox-from-hell
repositories.expected_description: Decision-driven workplace-horror browser game with data-driven outcomes, resilient local saves, accessible controls, and full-playthrough CI.
repositories.profile_summary: A six-shift workplace-horror browser game with 36 branching support cases, permanent department progression, accessible controls, resilient local saves, and automated full-campaign acceptance testing.

repositories.name: kalshi-10x1c-public
repositories.expected_description: Verification-led Kalshi order planner with dry-run-first controls and MIT-licensed source
repositories.profile_summary: A checksum-controlled educational entry planner demonstrating explicit activation, authenticated API use, duplicate-action prevention, execution caps, and safe stopping rules.

repositories.name: kalshi-15m-sell-bot-public-preview
repositories.expected_description: MIT-licensed, read-only Kalshi planning preview for API integration, reconciliation, and release governance.
repositories.profile_summary: A checksum-consistent dry-run exit-management preview with live writes blocked, polling limits, state checks, release verification, and explicit limits on what the public build can do.
